question: Belligerent Brontodon makes creatures assign combat damage using toughness instead of power. When Hunt the Weak makes a creature fight, does it deal damage equal to its toughness too?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the ability changes only the combat damage a creature assigns, not its power, so a fight still uses the real power.
expected.answer: Belligerent Brontodon’s ability doesn’t actually change any creature’s power. It changes only the amount of combat damage it assigns. All other rules and effects that check power or toughness use the real values. For example, Hunt the Weak won’t cause a creature to fight with its toughness.
